caution_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anticoagulant effects; galcanezumab may have minor platelet effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bleeding or bruising; maintain consistent dosing

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet activity; theoretical additive bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on bleeding precautions and report unusual symptoms

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: May worsen migraine frequency or trigger migraines; potential CNS effects with antibody therapy
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption and track migraine patterns; counsel on migraine triggers

monitoring_notes: Galcanezumab is a monoclonal antibody with minimal drug interactions due to lack of hepatic metabolism and CYP450 involvement. Monitor injection site reactions and migraine control; no routine laboratory monitoring required for interactions.
